external_context.finding: smartctl uses an exit-bitmask; bit 2 indicates a failed SMART/ATA command or checksum issue and bit 3 can mean SMART detected drive failing; nonzero need not mean all output is absent.
nvme smart-log is a read-only query returning SMART log data; output interpretation and command errors require separate source-specific semantics.

issue: How must the G5-04 private canonical status engine classify registered O1 capture PARTIAL/ACQUISITION_ERROR with actual nonzero exit_code, original sealed stdout/stderr, and explicit valid operator device consent? Only the owner may authorize expansion to the existing acquisition status pair.

alternatives.label: Conservative approved-status mapping — recommended
alternatives.decision: For registered O1 source attempt with outcome PARTIAL, reason ACQUISITION_ERROR, proven nonzero integer exit_code and >=1 SHA-verified original, emit existing acquisition PARTIAL/SOURCE_INCOMPLETE; require exact source policy/consent/target provenance, preserve recorded exit code, target identity and diagnostic originals in private receipt/status details. Never convert nonzero exit into 'drive failing' or 'healthy' without separate semantic evidence; never imply full acquisition. No new status pair, schema or privilege.
advantages: Allows validated private canonical partial session continuation even with SMART bitmask return
Applies only to O1 registered sources SRC-13/18/21 and does not broaden D1 rule
risks: Source result may be reported incomplete even if the nonzero bitmask reflects an actual health finding; raw exit code must remain available for later health analysis.
Needs negative/positive tests for both SMART and NVMe, and O1 privilege/consent boundaries.

alternatives.label: Source-specific status interpretation
alternatives.decision: Separate smartctl bitmask and nvme-cli exit semantics at the source adapter before mapping acquisition statuses. This requires an additional bounded design review and potentially changes to accepted G5-03 transport classification. No assumptions from code alone.
advantages: Most accurate distinction between command failure and observed health warnings
risks: Material change in approved acquisition status contract and tests, larger implementation

alternatives.label: Retain fail closed
alternatives.decision: Keep canonical rejection of PARTIAL/ACQUISITION_ERROR for O1. Preserve original evidence/receipt but block final canonical session when this occurs.
risks: Known SRC-13 exit-2 path will continue to block canonical session finalization.

recommendation: A as narrowly bounded to registered O1 source attempts with validated identity, target, nonzero exit and preserved original; defer device-health interpretation to separately verified parser evidence. Require explicit owner approval before implementing.
